name: Guinevere
source:
Promised to the legendary ruler of Camelot, you carry a secret that may be your new home's salvation... or its destruction.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Guinevere]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你向卡米洛特的传奇统治者许诺，你携带着一个秘密，这个秘密可能会拯救你的新家园……也可能会毁灭它。

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Guinevere]Choices Wikia[/url]]
